summary_for_children: As-Saff means The Ranks. It tells us to do what we say, praises believers united like a solid structure, and mentions Isa's disciples as supporters of Allah.
environment_concept: A wall of tightly joined stones (61:4).

story_library.title: Standing Together
story_library.children_narration: Surah As-Saff reminds us that our words and actions should agree. If we promise something good, we should try our best to do it. It also recalls Isa's message and encourages believers to support truth.

world_idea.title: The Workshop of Commitment
world_idea.description: Children work with a team of friendly fictional characters to complete a shared community project, learning that cooperation requires keeping promises.
